predicates.RepresentationPass: All required representation checks are PASS for exact subject/schema/generator bytes.
predicates.ValidationPass: All checks in the bound validation phase are PASS under applicable adopted standing.
predicates.EligibleBeforeDecision: Checks 01-12 PASS with current exact inputs, Decision check pending solely because it has not been selected; application check excluded.
predicates.AdmissionEffective: Exact eligible subject has selected applicable owner Decision and confirmed authorized application/lookup visibility.

implications: ValidationPass does not entail owner-reviewed or EligibleBeforeDecision.
EligibleBeforeDecision does not entail selected owner admission.
Selected owner Decision does not entail AdmissionEffective.
